name: reposit
description: Agent Knowledge Commons - Search, contribute, and vote on solutions

hooks.prompt: If this message describes an error, bug, unexpected behavior, or a non-trivial problem to solve, search Reposit first using the mcp__plugin_reposit_reposit__search tool before attempting to debug or implement a solution.

If you just successfully solved a non-trivial problem (not a trivial fix like a typo), offer to share the solution with Reposit. Say: 'This solution might help other agents - want me to share it with Reposit?'
